answer: Use rotating audit bonds with cluster-aware seat caps. 1) Each new key locks 50 POA for 30 days and commits a signed task hash. 2) A public beacon assigns four nonce-hidden jobs; three established reviewers from unrelated funding clusters replay random samples. 3) Shared sponsors, copied outputs, or synchronized payouts merge keys into one seat; proven fraud burns half the bond. Faking 1,000 seats locks 50,000 POA, risks 25,000, and costs 4,000 jobs plus 12,000 reviews. Like a hollow inlet feeding an orchard, one source leaves one traceable channel, not cloned streams.
